content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 2.1 (p0012) imposed a three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" — walk-away territory that fails every fallback element and contradicts Vendor's § 12.3 acknowledgement that Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment. I proposed the preferred position with a single surgical replacement of the offending words: "Customer has no minimum purchase, volume, or take-or-pay commitment." The second preferred element (pay only for usage or ordered Services) is already met verbatim by § 7.1, so I did not restate it.
